title: SEED Scheme (Scheme for Economic Empowerment of DNT):
summary: Schemes — SEED Scheme (Scheme for Economic Empowerment of DNT):

items: The SEED Scheme is designed to uplift Denotified Tribes (DNTs) by providing essential support in
o Educational Support: Free coaching for competitive exams and skill development.
o Health Coverage: Health insurance for DNT families to cover medical expenses.
o Economic Assistance: Financial aid for livelihood creation and small business ventures.
o Housing Support: Assistance in constructing safe and secure homes.
Eligibility: Families with an annual income of less than ₹2.5 lakhs.
The scheme aims to enhance the socio-economic status of DNT communities by improving access to
education, healthcare, livelihood opportunities, and housing.
